# How much tax will you owe when you sell your home?

> Free home sale tax calculator. Enter your sale price, purchase price and improvements to see how much gain the $250,000 or $500,000 exclusion covers, the tax on the rest, and what waiting to reach two years would save. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
